fields.name: save_data_lower_head
fields.description: Head of the lower 256-byte data block (file 0x000-0x0CF). Span is the register range of the lower CRC-8 loop in FUN_08685730; contents unresolved in the partial decomp.
fields.evidence: FUN_08685730 (lines 515-534) runs a CRC-8 loop over EEPROM-image bytes 0xFF down to 0x00 (hardcoded bounds) and verifies against the byte at 0x1FE; this field is the [0x000,0x0D0) head of that covered block, stopping before the decoded struct-tail bytes.

fields.name: save_state_mode
fields.description: Save-state/mode selector byte in the persistent struct tail: decomp default 0x7C, boot path writes 0x01, menu loop polls it for 0x7D/0x7E/0x7F.
fields.evidence: FUN_08685730 line 479 writes default 0x7C to save-struct byte +0xD0; FUN_08697cd8 line 1441 writes 0x01 to struct +0xD0 on the boot path and lines 1521-1531 poll that +0xD0 byte against 0x7D/0x7E/0x7F. Bases _DAT_086857ac/_DAT_08697e10 alias one EWRAM save struct (Ghidra overlap-aliasing); file offset 0xD0 in rev8-logical domain.

fields.name: option_flags
fields.description: Option flags byte; bit 7 is a persisted 1-bit option loaded via the bitstream reader, low 7 bits carry unknown option state (default 0x7F).
fields.evidence: FUN_08685d44 line 576 sets bit 7 of struct +0xD1 from a 1-bit value read by bitstream helper FUN_08696e2c; FUN_08685730 line 480 defaults the byte to 0x7F; FUN_08697cd8 line 1442 masks the byte with 0x80, keeping only bit 7. Same EWRAM-save-struct aliasing as save_state_mode; file offset 0xD1.

fields.name: save_gate
fields.description: Save-control flags byte; bit 0 gates the erase-and-rewrite path that zeroes the whole image and writes it back to EEPROM.
fields.evidence: FUN_08685730 line 548 tests bit 0 of struct +0xD2: when clear it memsets the 512-byte image to zero and calls FUN_086841bc for a full 0x40-block EEPROM rewrite; line 547 records the CRC validity result into flags word _DAT_086858b8. Same save-struct aliasing; file offset 0xD2.

fields.name: save_data_lower_tail
fields.description: Tail of the lower 256-byte data block (file 0x0D3-0x0FF). Covered by the same lower CRC-8 loop; contents unresolved in the partial decomp.
fields.evidence: FUN_08685730 (lines 515-534) CRC-8 loop covers EEPROM-image bytes 0xFF down to 0x00; this field is the [0x0D3,0x100) tail of that covered block, after the decoded struct-tail bytes.

fields.name: save_data_upper
fields.description: Upper data block (file 0x100-0x1FD). Covered by the upper CRC-8 loop; contents unresolved in the partial decomp (hero/progress state lives here).
fields.evidence: FUN_08685730 (lines 484-503) runs the upper CRC-8 loop from _DAT_086857b4-2 down to hardcoded 0x100; span end 0x1FD follows the _DAT_086857b4=0x1FF deduction (adjacent checksum slots, full non-overlapping coverage; see checksum_crc8_upper).

fields.name: checksum_crc8_lower
fields.description: Stored verification byte for file range 0x000-0x0FF (custom CRC-8: MSB-first, poly 0xCD, init 0, 8 zero-bit flush, final XOR 0x22). Kept as u8: custom algorithm has no Schema v2 id and baseline 0xFF does not verify.
fields.evidence: FUN_08685730 lines 515-543: second CRC-8 loop folds bytes 0xFF..0x00 (MSB-first, overflow XORs 0xCD/0xCC), clocks 8 flush bits, compares (state ^ 0x22) & 0xFF against the EEPROM-image byte at hardcoded file offset 0x1FE.

fields.name: checksum_crc8_upper
fields.description: Stored verification byte for file range 0x100-0x1FD (same custom CRC-8). Kept as u8 for the same reason as checksum_crc8_lower.
fields.evidence: FUN_08685730 lines 484-513: first CRC-8 loop folds bytes from _DAT_086857b4-2 down to hardcoded 0x100 and compares against the byte at _DAT_086857b4. _DAT_086857b4=0x1FF is deduced: it must exceed 0x100 (loop termination), differ from 0x1FE (distinct checksum slot at line 543), and 0x1FF alone yields full non-overlapping coverage (0x100-0x1FD plus checksums at 0x1FE/0x1FF).
